questions.label: What should Browser navigation default to?
questions.help: Recommended: allow user-directed public URL navigation and ask for agent-initiated logged-in or sensitive Browser actions. This keeps normal browsing easy while preserving agent authority boundaries.
options: Allow user-directed public URL navigation; ask agent-initiated sensitive Browser actions
Allow all Browser navigation and actions

questions.label: What should screenshots and annotations default to?
questions.help: Recommended: user-triggered screenshots/annotations attach without asking; agent-triggered capture asks when it may expose logged-in or sensitive content.
options: User-triggered capture attaches without asking; sensitive agent-triggered capture asks
Ask before every screenshot or annotation attachment
